desc: Ideation: reduce each T/F window to a KMP-state constraint on end position i+m-1 ('T' -> state==m, 'F' -> state!=m); DP over (position, state).

Implement KMP automaton (including correct fail/transition from full-match state m), backward bitset feasibility DP F[p] using chunked preimage-OR, and greedy forward lexicographically-smallest construction; return "" when state 0 is infeasible in F[0].
Validate on examples 1-3 (got "ababa", "", "a") and brute-force exhaustively for n<=4, m<=3 over all T/F patterns and str2 alphabets, plus randomized trials; no counterexamples found.
Confirm larger random validity sweep (n<=40, m<=8): every nonempty output satisfies all T/F constraints.
